summary.name: CrewAI
summary.one_liner: CrewAI is an enterprise platform for building, running, governing, and optimizing multi-agent AI workflows, with a no-code visual editor and a code-first API.
use_cases: Identify which business processes to automate with AI agents
Build multi-agent workflows with a visual or prompt-based builder
Govern and audit agents in production
Trace LLM and tool calls with cost accounting
Test and swap LLMs across workflows
Add PII redaction and policy checks to agent actions
summary.what_it_does: CrewAI offers a Discovery feature that suggests automation opportunities ranked by effort, value, and readiness, based on the page's claimed patterns from agent runs. Its Build component provides a prompt- and canvas-based multi-agent builder with a no-code visual editor that exports to Python, plus a code-first API with role-based agents and deterministic workflows. The Govern layer, called the Control Plane, offers real-time tracing of LLM calls, tool calls, and memory reads, RBAC, immutable audit trails, human-in-the-loop approval gates, and runtime hooks for PII redaction and policy checks. The Optimize component covers automated and human-guided training, multi-LLM testing for model swapping, and evaluation integrations with Arize, Galileo, DataDog, and Patronus.
notable: Visual no-code editor that exports to Python, alongside a code-first API
Control Plane with tracing, audit trails, and human-in-the-loop approval gates
Evaluation integrations with Arize, Galileo, DataDog, and Patronus
caveats: Page is mostly marketing; specific pricing tiers and open-source status are not stated on the page
Governance and enterprise features are positioned for enterprise customers
